name: Literature and reading library
one_line: Published work by OTHER people, kept for reading: papers, preprints, chapters and the bibliography files that index them. The situation is recognised by third-party publication structure, not by a project identifier, so its leading dimension is the one fact it usually cannot supply — which is why 00 gives this material a residual home and why this row exists to carry the falls_through_to edge to it.
design_cite: Extends 00's named Research domain ("Research files may use project, stage, artifact type, lab, and venue") to the one situation 00 describes only from the residual side: Reading Inbox holds "papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association". The template object it fills is 00's: "Each template should define the domain’s allowed fact fields, detection signals, recommended folder dimensions, preferred dimension order, optional branch patterns, privacy rules, and validation constraints." No 00 sentence names a reading-library template, so the row is inference, not design.

node_test.why:
The template half of CONNECTION.md section 2's node test asks whether detection signals, recommended dimensions, or privacy rules differ from the schema's default template. All three do, and the row also discharges a CONNECTION invariant that nothing else can.

1. DETECTION SIGNALS — inverted, not narrowed. The research schema activates on a project-identifier token beside the HOLDER'S OWN research-artifact structure (a manuscript title block, numbered protocol steps, a figure-caption sequence). This situation has none of that: its evidence is a third party's published-article structure — a DOI or masthead in the title zone, an abstract heading over a numbered reference list, an author-and-affiliation block naming people the holder is not. The research schema row lists exactly that evidence under never_alone ("a DOI, a journal name, or a citation string alone"), so this row's positive signals are the schema's negative ones. That is a different detection signal set, not a copy.

2. DIMENSIONS — project then artifact_type, with stage struck. The schema default is 00's own "a Research template may define project → stage → artifact type". stage is the HOLDER'S workflow position (draft, under review, revision, proof); a third party's published paper occupies none of it, and the version suffix or publication year that a reading item does carry is a version_family / creation_date universal, not a stage. Recommending a level no fact in this situation can fill is precisely what the contract's dimension rule forbids, so the honest recommendation is two levels, not three.

3. PRIVACY RULES — the one part of Research that is not potentially_sensitive. The schema row's sensitivity reasoning is human-subjects material, unpublished manuscripts and editorial correspondence. None of those is this situation's material: a published paper by somebody else carries no holder-personal content. sensitivity here is none, with the two carve-outs recorded in sensitivity_why.

4. THE EDGE THAT ONLY THIS ROW CAN CARRY. CONNECTION.md section 5, invariant 5: a residual home that shadows a domain template must be connected by falls_through_to from that template or it is a duplicate, not a fallback. Reading Inbox is defined by 00 in this domain's own vocabulary. Without this row the residual shadows the Research schema with no edge joining them; with it, the associated case is a template and the unassociated case is its named fallthrough. Refusing this id would not delete the situation — it would leave 00's own residual unattached.

WHAT THIS ROW IS NOT: it is not the Reading Inbox residual wearing a template id. The residual is 00's home for material with "no reliable deeper association"; this template is the case where an association exists and is evidenced on the file itself. The two are complements joined by one edge, which is the shape CONNECTION prescribes.

fields_note: Empty by contract, not by omission: a template references its schema's fields and never copies them (CONNECTION.md section 3, rule 1). Which of the research schema's fields this situation actually REACHES, and at what ceiling, is the substantive finding and is carried by the file_examples' facts_legal lists and by template.why — not by a second field list. In short: artifact_type and venue are reachable as direct or validated facts from the publication itself; authored_by is reachable and is never a destination; project is usually reachable only as `possible`, or not at all; stage and lab are not this situation's facts.

deterministic: a published-article structure in the page-one/title zone: a DOI or arXiv identifier (the `doi` and `arxiv` kinds of the injected citation_identifier_patterns list, 06-citation-identifier-patterns) co-occurring with an abstract heading, an author-and-affiliation block, and a numbered reference list. 00 requires the PDF extractor to preserve "DOI values, citations, identifiers, and other structured strings that may later support file facts", and the zone requirement is 00's positional rule: "A course code or university name found in a filename, title, or page-one heading is more meaningful than the same text appearing once in a reference list on page eighteen."

a journal or publisher masthead gazetteer hit (R4's content) at a word boundary in the title zone or the running page header — never from a hit confined to the reference_list zone, which is where the injected list's `citation` kind is mapped

a bibliography-catalogue structure read as structured text: repeated entry records each carrying author, title, journal and year keys (a .bib, .ris or .csl file). 00 routes these through the "lighter structured-text extractor" and the entries are ABOUT other documents, so the catalogue is the artifact and its entries are not facts about it

an ISBN or ISSN hit that passes the check digit the injected list requires (a shape match without a passing checksum is not a hit), co-occurring with a copyright-page or serial-front-matter structure — the book-chapter and serial half of this situation

an archive manifest whose member names are author-year shaped and which contains a bibliography-format member, read without unpacking — 00: "the normal scan should never extract archive contents to the filesystem"

a project-identifier token in the filename or title zone of a file whose structure is a third-party publication. This is a deterministic signal that produces a `possible`-grade project clue and nothing stronger: the schema's validated rule family requires the token beside the holder's own research-artifact context, which a paper by somebody else does not supply
needs_llm: whether a publication is the holder's own output or somebody else's — the role question, which decides between this situation and research.manuscript-publication, and which no gazetteer answers. 00 gives the model this job ("interpret an unusual research artifact") and the standing constraint that it "must return unknown where support is insufficient"

whether a project token in a reading item's filename records a real association (this paper was read for that project) or a filing habit (every download gets the prefix) — the difference between a `possible` clue and a reviewable group membership
whether an OCR'd scan with no DOI is a book chapter, a journal article, a report, or the holder's own draft printed and scanned
whether a saved capture is a reading item or one of 00's Reference Clips — that residual names "short article captures" explicitly, and the boundary is interpretive
whether a reading item is assigned coursework reading (which puts academic evidence on the same file) or self-directed reading
never_alone: A DOI, a journal name, an ISBN, or a citation string alone. This is the constitutive never-alone of this row: that evidence recognises the SITUATION and supplies no destination-eligible fact, which is exactly why 00 gives the material a residual rather than a branch. The tempting false file is the holder's OWN manuscript — PVA-RDP_manuscript_v7.docx carries a full reference list of other people's journal names on its late pages, and a library detector reading mastheads without zone restriction would file the holder's own work as reading material. 00's positional rule is the discriminator and the injected list maps the `citation` kind to the reference_list zone for this reason.

A bare 4-digit number as a year, a term, or an identifier — the leading digits of an arXiv id and the year in an author-year filename are both this trap. 00: "numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values"; the injected citation list carries the same rule in its own form (a bare number is never an identifier; the label is required).

A parent folder named for a project as proof that a paper inside it belongs to that project. A downloaded paper saved into a project directory is the standard cross-fixture with research.project-workspace; folder context is an activation input, never a licence to write the project fact onto the file.
A download session as the topic or the project of the papers in it — 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic".

An author-year filename alone as an authorship fact; and even a correct authorship fact is never a folder level — 00: "It should avoid using authorship or creator identity as a destination dimension." This matters more here than anywhere else in the schema, because author-first is the reference-manager convention users arrive with.

A source_type or extension alone. text_document, ocr, archive, email, code_structured and image all appear in a reading library and none makes it plausible; 00 requires the engine to "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning".
A journal masthead in an email's sender domain as a venue fact about the holder — a table-of-contents alert is mail about publications, not a publication.

work_types_note: Values of the research schema's artifact_type field, discovered at runtime; none is a roster node and none licenses a child schema. The schema row already carries `literature paper` and `preprint`; the other seven are a value-list gap for R1c to fold into that row, not new fields and not new nodes.
grouping_reasons: one paper across its copies: a preprint, the published version, and an annotated reading copy — duplicate and version families, which 00 lists among the typed relationships ("duplicate or version links") and which are universal facts rather than research facts

the set of readings cited by one of the holder's own manuscripts — 00 lists "direct references" as a typed relationship, and a reference-list link is the one association here that comes from the holder's own artifact rather than from a filename
one reference-manager library or export: an archive plus its bibliography member plus the PDFs the entries name

a project's or a course's reading set, where the association is a REVIEWABLE MEMBERSHIP and not a fact. A paper joins the PVA/RDP neighbourhood without acquiring project = PVA/RDP — 00: "The graph does not automatically copy those missing facts onto sparse files". This is the HW 3 discipline applied to reading material, and it is why this template's leading dimension is often populated by an accepted group rather than by an extracted fact: "Each template is populated from the facts and accepted groups that already exist in the evidence database."
a bounded download session, as a `possible`-grade retrieval clue only — it may bring four papers into one packet and it proves nothing about their topic

template.why:
project leads because it is the only association that makes somebody else's paper filable inside the holder's tree at all, and because 00's ordering rule puts it there: "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders." artifact_type follows because a review article, a book chapter and a preprint are the distinctions a reader actually navigates once inside a reading set, and because it is intelligible under project in the way 00 requires of a child dimension.

STAGE IS STRUCK from the schema default. stage is the holder's workflow position on the holder's own artifact; a published paper by somebody else occupies none of it, and the version suffix or publication year a reading item does carry is a version_family or creation_date universal. Recommending a level nothing can fill is the defect the dimension rule exists to prevent.

lab and venue stay LEGAL FACTS and are deliberately metadata_only here (P10's per-dimension mechanism). venue is the tempting one — a reading library genuinely knows its journals — but branching on it produces one folder per journal over a long tail of single papers, which is what 00 warns against: "It should warn when a level produces only one child" and when a split "creates a large number of tiny folders", and "It should recommend flattening when a dimension does not materially improve retrieval." lab is worse: for a paper by others, the affiliation describes its authors, and an author-or-affiliation level is the collector 00 forbids outright.

VALIDATION CONSTRAINT, specific to this row: the leading dimension is the fact this situation usually cannot supply. When no project association is evidenced on the file, the branch has no first level and the honest destination is the Reading Inbox residual, not a deeper path invented to fill the shape — 00: "An isolated file should normally remain high in the tree because there is no evidence that it deserves a deep project-specific path."

OPTIONAL BRANCH PATTERNS: (a) flat — a single Reading branch with no levels, correct for a small library and the shape most users already have; (b) artifact_type-first, for a reader who separates books from papers before anything else; (c) venue-first, available if the user asks for it and never recommended, for the reasons above. All three are the user's to choose: "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions."

collides_with.signal: One evidence item — a list or a set of published articles with authors, journals and years — supports both. The discriminator is which pattern the item sits beside: a course-code pattern with academic context (00's own floor: "a course-code pattern together with academic context") makes the file coursework, while a publication's OWN structure (masthead or DOI in the title zone, abstract heading, its own reference apparatus) makes it a reading item. Fixture: Reading list — Week 4.pdf is the instructor's list and belongs to academic.coursework; PHYS1401_reading_Feynman1963.pdf carries both evidence sets and is the co-activation case, not the collision.

One evidence item — a manuscript-shaped PDF with an abstract, a reference list and a journal name — supports both, and getting it wrong is the expensive error in this domain (the holder's unpublished draft filed as reading material, or somebody else's paper filed into the holder's submission packet). The discriminator is whose artifact it is: an author list that resolves to a user-confirmed identity value, a draft or track-changes structure, a submission-lifecycle term, or a cover letter puts the file on research.manuscript-publication; a publisher masthead, a typeset final-form layout and an author list resolving to nobody the holder is put it here. Where neither side resolves, this is the LLM's role question and abstention is the correct outcome.

falls_through_to.why: 00 defines this residual in exactly this situation's words — it holds "papers, articles, reports, and saved PDFs that appear to be reading material but have no active research, course, or project association" — and CONNECTION.md section 5's fifth invariant requires the template it shadows to name it, or it is a duplicate rather than a fallback. This is the primary and expected outcome for the material: the template's leading dimension is the fact a reading item usually cannot supply. Fixtures: Ravikumar_2019_NatureMethods.pdf, 2103.02702.pdf, library.bib, zotero_export.zip, chapter7_scan.pdf.

00 puts "short article captures" inside this residual by name, alongside "saved visual inspiration, product references, quotes, recipes". A screenshot of a paper's listing page is a capture of reading material, not the reading material, and Reference Clips is where 00 already sends it. Fixture: Screenshot 2026-04-02 at 10.15.03.png.

00: "files whose meaning is partly understood but whose final location requires a future decision". A publisher alert email is understood — it is mail about publications — without being a reading item or a record worth keeping in place. Fixture: Nature Methods — Table of contents alert.eml.

DRM-protected ebooks and password-protected reader archives are ordinary members of a real reading library, and 00 requires them to be represented rather than forced open or treated as empty. Fixture: monograph_2024.epub.

sensitivity_why: This is the one part of the Research domain whose material carries no holder-personal content: published or preprinted work by other people, held for reading. The research schema row's potentially_sensitive is sourced to human-subjects material, unpublished manuscripts and editorial correspondence, and none of those is this situation's. Two carve-outs are recorded rather than folded in, because both belong elsewhere: a manuscript received for peer review is confidential and is research.manuscript-publication's material, not a reading item; and where the situation touches mail, 00's own rule governs that file — mail extraction proceeds "while treating addresses and message content as potentially sensitive", which is why the alert-email fixture routes to Review Later instead of into a reading branch. The value is 00's phrase and nothing more; a handling class is P7's and none is assigned here.
open_question: Two, both real and neither resolvable by this node. (1) THE HOLDER-IDENTITY VALUE. This template's sharpest discriminator against research.manuscript-publication — is the author list the holder's or somebody else's — cannot be evaluated deterministically unless the product holds a user-confirmed value naming the holder and their name variants. 00 gives the product no such value: authored_by is a field, and there is no `me` to compare it against. Without one, whose-paper-is-this is an LLM role question on every file, which is expensive and abstains often. Joseph's call: does v1 ask the user once for their own name and affiliations (a user_confirmed value, not a new field), or does the role question stay interpretive? (2) VENUE AS A DIMENSION. venue is destination_eligible on the canonical row and this template deliberately does not branch on it, on 00's one-child and tiny-folders warnings. Some readers genuinely do organize by journal. Whether that is a user-chosen reordering of this template or a second template on the same schema decides someone's real folder structure and is not settled here.
